description_en: Adds a replication pair to a replication pair-consistent group. You can use a replication pair-consistent group to batch manage replication pairs. When you call this operation, you can specify parameters, such as ReplicaGroupId, ReplicaPairId, and ClientToken, in the request
description_zh: 调用AddDiskReplicaPair接口，并可以指定ReplicaGroupId、ReplicaPairId、ClientToken等参数，添加复制对到一致性复制组，最终通过一致性复制组，您可以批量管理复制对
kebab_example: aliyun ebs add-disk-replica-pair --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --replica-group-id pg-myreplica0000 --replica-pair-id pair-cn-dsa0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: AddDiskReplicaPair

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the replication pair-consistent group
parameters.help_zh: 一致性复制组所属的地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the replication pair-consistent group
parameters.name: replica_group_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the replication pair. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/354206.html operation to query the IDs of existing replication pairs
parameters.help_zh: 复制对ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/354206.html查询已创建的复制对ID
parameters.name: replica_pair_id

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html
parameters.help_zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html
parameters.name: client_token
